name: Eltech Engineers Pvt Ltd
india_angle: All systems are designed and manufactured in India, supporting the nation’s vision of 'Make in India' for semiconductors.
summary: Eltech Engineers Pvt Ltd specializes in manufacturing equipment for semiconductor surface treatment and static control. Their offerings include plasma systems for cleaning and adhesion, ozone generators for eco-friendly processing, and static control devices to ensure manufacturing safety. They are committed to innovation and sustainability, with all products made in India.
